{{Hatnote|This is the dated constructed pool of September 2012 – March 2013. For the fixed pre-reset pool played since 2014, see [[Legacy Open]]. For all pools of this era, see [[Virtual Legacy#Constructed pools|Virtual Legacy]].}}
'''Premiere - Virtual Block 8.2''' is the constructed card pool of every Decipher card plus the [[Players Committee]] virtual cards through [[Agents For Hire (Virtual Block 8)|Virtual Block 8.2: Agents For Hire]]. The 8.2 PDF has official text as of 14 September 2012, and the Players Committee posted "8.2 Released!" on 20 September 2012.<ref name="pdf82">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf ''Virtual Block 8: Agents For Hire''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of September 14, 2012". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020184623/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf?copy=2 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="hp201209">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org home page], Players Committee (Latest News list: "September CBT Changes", 14 September 2012; "8.2 Released!", 20 September 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20120930100132/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ Internet Archive, 30 September 2012]</ref> No tournament-legal date was found; in June 2012 the plan had been legality one week after release.<ref name="j339">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=339&catid=1&Itemid=117 Virtual Set 8.2 announcement], Players Committee (29 June 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20120818111316/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=339&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref> Decklists of the [[2012 World Championship]] (12–14 October 2012) use 8.2 cards such as [[Lady Luck]] and [[Lando Calrissian, Unlikely Hero]].<ref name="ev-2012 World Championship">Decklists of the [[2012 World Championship]] on this wiki.</ref> The pool lasted until Virtual Block 8.3 (official text 28 March 2013) became legal; that date is unknown.<ref name="pdf83">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_3.pdf ''Virtual Block 8: A Wretched Hive''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of March 28, 2013". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174721/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee's name for its constructed format until 2014 was ''Standard'': the 25 July 2014 announcement that replaced this pool was titled "Reset of Standard Format" and said that "The new Standard tournament format will consist of all post-reset V Cards".<ref name="reset">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/reset-of-standard-format/ Reset of Standard Format], Players Committee, Advocate Council (byline darkjediknight11) (25 July 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20141020142523/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/wp/reset-of-standard-format/ Internet Archive]</ref> "Legacy" was created only then, for the pre-reset cards.

* '''Type:''' constructed
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee
* '''Card pool:''' every Decipher card plus Virtual Blocks 1–7 and Virtual Block 8.1–8.2 (and, from January 2013, the 8.3 Preview Set)
* '''In use:''' September 2012 (released 20 September; legal date unknown) – March 2013
* '''GEMP:''' none (GEMP's ''Legacy'' environment is the later fixed pool, [[Legacy Open]])

== Card pool ==
The pool is every Decipher card plus every Players Committee virtual release up to and including [[Agents For Hire (Virtual Block 8)|8.2 Agents For Hire]]:

* Every card printed by Decipher.
* The earlier numbered Virtual Sets 1–17, including [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields|Defensive Shields]], as realigned in 2009 into [[Virtual Block 1|Virtual Blocks 1–5]].<ref name="vb1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf ''Virtual Block 1''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of December 7, 2009". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="w-reorg">[[2009 Virtual Block Reorganization]]</ref>

Changes made while this pool was in force:

* 14 September 2012: "September CBT Changes" (headline only in the preserved copy used here).<ref name="hp201209" />
* 30 October 2012: errata to Floating Refinery (V).<ref name="j347">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=347&catid=1&Itemid=117 Changes to Floating Refinery (v)], Players Committee (30 October 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003457/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=347&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref>
* 29 January 2013: persona name changes, "in effect immediately"; "The old slips will be considered valid for tournament play."<ref name="j350">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 New Persona Changes], Players Committee (29 January 2013). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref>

== History ==
8.2 was first announced for July 2012 and then postponed.<ref name="j339" /><ref name="hp201208">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org home page], Players Committee (Latest News list: "Change to virtual set 8.2 release date", 6 July 2012; "v8.2 Preview Spoiler List", 14 July 2012; "4-card Virtual Set 8.2 Preview!", 20 July 2012; "An announcement on V8.2", 8 August 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20120828093455/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ Internet Archive, 28 August 2012]</ref> Compared with [[Premiere - Virtual Block 8.1]], the pool adds the 28 Agents For Hire cards (11 Dark Side, 17 Light Side).<ref name="w-afh" />

'''8.3 Preview Set.''' On 20 December 2012 the Players Committee posted "the 4 cards that make up the 8.3 Preview Set" and wrote: "It is our intention that these will be legal for use in the MPC."<ref name="j348">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=348&catid=1&Itemid=117 Merry Christmas, SWCCG!], Players Committee (20 December 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003503/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=348&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref> Decklists of the [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (24–27 January 2013) include preview cards such as [[Black Market Blaster]] and [[Carbonite Chamber Console (V) (Dark)|Carbonite Chamber Console (V)]].<ref name="ev-2013 Match Play Championship">Decklists of the [[2013 Match Play Championship]] on this wiki.</ref> These cards are also in the later 8.3 release, A Wretched Hive.<ref name="w-awh">[[A Wretched Hive (Virtual Block 8)]]</ref> This wiki does not treat the preview as a separate pool: from January 2013 this pool is 8.2 plus the four preview cards. The exact date they became legal is not known.
